items.text: Justin Jefferson expected to play, Jordan Addison not expected to play. Both were GTDs.
items.why: ETR update from weekend reports and pregame.
items.implication: Start Jefferson; fade or bench Addison. Potential boost to other Vikings pass catchers if Addison out.
items.opportunity: If Addison out, more targets to Jefferson/others.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja’Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, both listed as questionable, both will play against the Dolphins.
Cardinals WR Marvin Harrison Jr will be inactive today and is soon-to-be traded.
items.why: Insiders report on NFL GameDay; finalizing deal.
items.implication: MHJ non-factor; massive boost to Michael Wilson and other Cardinals WRs vs DET.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey, who didn’t practice this week and is listed as questionable due to a foot injury, is not expected to play vs. the Broncos.
items.why: Schefter report; no practice all week.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; look to other Chargers WRs like Quentin Johnston for upside.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Chargers receivers.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (plantar fasciitis flare + ankle) is hopeful to play but not definite; will work out pregame. Team elevated a RB in case.
items.implication: Monitor warmups closely; have backup ready. If out, elevate handcuff.

items.text: NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY: Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison, Darius Slayton, Josh Palmer.
items.why: ETR weekend reports summary; aligns with beat/insider notes. Messiest injury week.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers, listed as questionable for Sunday night due to a foot injury, is expected to play vs. the Falcons.
items.implication: Start Flowers with confidence in SNF.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) is expected to play against the Vikings.
Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is expected to play.
Steelers RB Rico Dowdle is unlikely to play Sunday vs. the Colts due to a toe injury; final determination in pre-game warmups.
items.implication: Elevate Jaylen Warren as lead back.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games and wasn't a real factor; post-inactive/trade it's Kia Kendrick Bourne / Michael Wilson season. MHJ non-factor elevates Wilson.
items.why: Usage data shows MHJ limited impact; trade/inactive clears path.
items.implication: Strongly elevate Wilson in rankings/lineups vs DET.
items.opportunity: Wilson target share and snap increase.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; MHJ inactive/trade boosts his volume including red zone.
items.why: Volume spike post-MHJ news; soft matchup elements.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume and red-zone usage vs soft Titans secondary.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; strong usage and matchup vs Dolphins run defense.
items.why: Workload and defense getting carved by RBs; Bengals context.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO as WR41; tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
items.why: Usage numbers and matchup; now reinforced by expected out.

items.text: Hates Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20) for efficiency/game environment; Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28) similar; Jalen Hurts vs JAX (QB15) due to rough stretch and banged-up line.
items.why: Poor efficiency spots and situational concerns.
